Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for issuing a writ of mandamus directing the
respondents to grant compensation to the petitioner and his family members according to their
shares in Arazi no.714 Kha, Rakba- 0.029 hectare and 719 Kha, Rakba- 0.045 hectare, Village-
Gajepur, Pargana- Kaswar Raja, Tehsil- Rajatalab, District- Varanasi.
2.  The case of the petitioner is that the respondents had acquired both plots i.e., 714 and 719 under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956.

However, the petitioner and his other family members have been given a notice under Section 3E calling upon them to approach the competent authority and accept compensation in respect of super-structure exiting over Plot no.719.

sentences.text: for compensation has been made in respect of Plot no.714, although, it was also acquired.
The other grievance is that the acquisition has been made by treating the land as agricultural whereas the petitioner was entitled to compensation at the commercial rate.

3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of NHAI submits that the entire compensation amount is in deposit with the competent authority and it is open to the petitioner to approach the competent authority and withdraw the compensation amount.

4. Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the State-respondents submits that the dispute is relating to enhancement of compensation for which the petitioner can avail appropriate remedy.

5. Having considered the rival submissions, we dispose of the instant petition by providing that the petitioner may avail the remedy provided under the Act for getting the compensation enhanced, if he is aggrieved by the amount awarded.

In respect of his grievance regarding Plot no.714 for which no offer for release of compensation has been made, we leave it open to the petitioner to approach the competent authority and in which event, the competent authority will pass a speaking order on his representation within six weeks from the date of receipt of the representation.
(Manish Kumar Nigam, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 8.7.2024 Ankit.
